sloka: कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथा अयम् मारुतात्मजः ।कृत्यवान् सोऽपि संप्राप्तः कृत कृत्योऽसि राघव ॥४-४-३१॥
transliteration: kapiḥ kathayate hṛṣṭo yathā ayam mārutātmajaḥ ।kṛtyavān so'pi saṁprāptaḥ kṛta kṛtyo'si rāghava ॥4-4-31॥

translations.english: 'O Raghava this monkey, son of the Windgod appears pleased as evident from his words. As he is a man of action, take your work as accomplished now.
